name: Atmastco Ltd.
summary: Atmastco Ltd. is an Indian engineering company primarily engaged in providing Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) services within the ferrous and non-ferrous sectors. The company designs, manufactures, and supplies precision equipment and heavy fabrication structures, including girders, columns, and ducts, utilized in power, energy, steel, cement, railway, water treatment, refinery, and fertilizer plants, as well as general industrial and infrastructure projects. Additionally, through its subsidiary, Atmastco Defence Systems Private Limited, it manufactures bulletproof jackets and helmets for paramilitary and military forces. The company also trades in various industrial goods such as steel, chemical alloys, metals, grinding wheels, and welding electrodes. Its operations are vertically integrated, offering comprehensive solutions from project planning and design to site management and quality assurance for a diverse clientele across public and private sectors in India.
